latestVersion.changelog:
AI Subtitle in VLC — Initial Release

- Launches a tool to generate and embed AI-generated subtitles directly into user-uploaded video files (MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV; up to 500MB).
- No manual VLC setup needed: output files are ready-to-play with hardcoded subtitles.
- Simple workflow: upload video, describe the desired result, and download a 1080p MP4 with embedded subtitles in 1-2 minutes.
- Supports free usage via in-app anonymous token system, with 100 free credits for new users.
- Clear error handling for uploads, exports, authentication, and plan limits.
- Designed for casual viewers and students who want quick, hassle-free subtitle embedding.
